basis: R2R3-MYB required for oil body formation (mutant lacks oil bodies, Wang 2023 Fig 3E-H; Kubo 2018 as cited); oil-body-only reporter in two independent studies (Romani 2024 Plant Cell DS1; Wang 2023 Dev Cell LW881); Wang cluster 18 DE pct 0.365 vs 0.001. Cross-study.

AP2/ERF regulator of oil body formation upstream of MpMYB02 (Kanazawa 2020 as cited, not re-read); oil-body-only reporter (Romani 2024 DS1); cluster-18 feature plot in Wang 2023 Fig S2H but absent from its DE table; only 11 gemma scRNA cells, so weak in scRNA. Cross-study.

Class I HD-Zip needed for oil body formation (Romani 2020 Curr Biol as cited); reporter strongest in oil body cells but weak (score 1) in all other gemma domains (Romani 2024 DS1); Wang 2023 DE in cluster 18 (0.67 vs 0.14) and 17. Raised from medium by cross-study agreement; not restricted, use with MYB02/ERF13.
Oil-body membrane syntaxin (Kanazawa 2016 as cited by Wang, not re-read; would raise to high if its reporter is confirmed); Wang 2023 cluster 18 DE pct 0.341 vs 0.002. Text spells it "MpSPY12B".
ABC transporter cited as an oil-body marker; Wang 2023 reporter LW936 in oil body cells and cluster 18 DE pct 0.374 vs 0.006.
Uncharacterized; reporter in oil body cells (Wang 2023 Fig S2C, LW894) and cluster 18 DE pct 0.85 vs 0.05.
Uncharacterized; reporter in oil body cells (Wang 2023 Fig 2B, LW940); not in the cluster-18 DE table.
Uncharacterized; reporter "oil body cells" in Wang 2023 Table S1 only (LW902, no image); cluster 18 DE pct 0.387 vs 0.005.
WRKY TF; reporter scores 2 in oil bodies and in rhizoid precursors (Romani 2024 DS1); Wang 2023 cluster 18 DE (0.643 vs 0.126). Raised from low by cross-study agreement; check rhizoid expression.
bHLH; reporter only in oil body cells (Romani 2024 DS1) but detected in 0 Wang gemma scRNA cells: supports a cluster call, not a scRNA marker alone.
B3/REM TF; reporter only in oil body cells (Romani 2024 Fig 2E, DS1); 18 gemma scRNA cells. ID from DS1 only (absent from UniProt).

HSF needed for normal air pores (mutant has fewer, defective pores; Wang 2023 Fig 3A-D); cluster 17 DE pct 0.635 vs 0.019; no reporter. Gemma reporter broad near the notch (Romani 2024 DS1), before pores form.
Transaldolase; reporter in barrel cells (Wang 2023 Fig 2A, LW903, Primers sheet; not on the reporter sheet); cluster 17 DE pct 0.432 vs 0.006.
NF-YC; air-pore reporter in mature thallus (Romani 2024 Fig 8A) and Wang 2023 cluster 17 DE (0.676 vs 0.28, enriched not specific); gemma reporter broad (SCZ/DDCZ/mucilage). Cross-study, partial.
Phosphate transporter; reporter in air pore cells (Wang 2023 Fig S2A, LW1062) but DE in clusters 1 (0.38 vs 0.04) and 17 (0.32 vs 0.10).
Uncharacterized; reporter in air pore cells and epidermis (Wang 2023 Table S1, B2); cluster 17 DE pct 0.313 vs 0.005.
C3H zinc finger; air-pore reporter in mature thallus (Romani 2024 Fig 8A), but broad in gemma (SCZ/DDCZ/rhizoid/mucilage = 2 in DS1).
Uncharacterized; reporter in rhizoids (Wang 2023 LRY017) and cluster 15 DE pct 0.507 vs 0.018. ID from Wang Table S1 (absent from UniProt).
Phytocyanin; nuclear reporter in rhizoids (Wang 2023 Fig 2C, LRY417); not in the cluster-15 DE table.
RSL bHLH (MpBHLH33); reporter strong in rhizoid precursors and rhizoids (Romani 2024 Fig 5B; also Sauret-Gueto 2020, same lab, not independent); detected in 1 gemma scRNA cell.
R2R3-MYB (UniProt A0A1B4Z1R7 "MpMYB33-like"); reporter only in rhizoid precursors (Romani 2024 DS1); 23 gemma scRNA cells.
AP2/ERF; reporter only in proximal rhizoid precursors near the apex (Romani 2024 Fig 5B); positional sub-state.
CONFLICT: reporter in proximal rhizoid precursors and SCZ/DDCZ/mucilage (Romani 2024 DS1), but Wang 2023 DE is air-pore cluster 17 (0.521 vs 0.011). ID from DS1 (absent from UniProt).
Uncharacterized; reporter in mucilage hairs at the notch (Wang 2023 Fig 2F, LRY328); cluster 21 DE log2FC 5.4, pct 0.632 vs 0.036.
Uncharacterized; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LW878); cluster 21 DE pct 0.974 vs 0.01.
Fasciclin-like AGP; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LW906); cluster 21 DE pct 0.868 vs 0.037.
Arabinogalactan protein; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LW924, sheet says "cluster 22"); cluster 21 DE pct 0.632 vs 0.039.
Chitinase; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LW888); cluster 21 DE pct 0.632 vs 0.003.
bZIP; reporter in mucilage papillae (Romani 2024 Fig 5B; DS1 mucilage 2, SCZ/DDCZ 1). Not in Wang DE.
Class II RSL bHLH (UniProt A0A0S3CWB8 "RSL2"); reporter only in mucilage papillae (Romani 2024 DS1); 6 gemma scRNA cells.
AB hydrolase; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LW917) but DE in Undefined cluster 13 (0.788 vs 0.039), not 21.
Uncharacterized; reporter in mucilage hairs (Wang 2023 LRY338) but DE in rhizoid cluster 15 (0.547 vs 0.043): cluster 15 may hold mucilage cells.
Dirigent; reporter in ventral scales (Wang 2023 LRY006) but on the protoplast-induced list removed before clustering: expect induction in stressed cells.
Dirigent; reporter in ventral scales (Wang 2023 LRY315); protoplast-induced (removed before clustering).
HMA domain; reporter in ventral scales (Wang 2023 Fig 2D) but Table S1 DE is oil-body cluster 18 (0.391 vs 0.062), not cluster 6 as the text says.
Chlorophyll a/b-binding protein; reporter at the air-chamber floor (Wang 2023 Fig 2E) and cluster 19 DE pct 0.776 vs 0.005; photosynthesis gene, weak in green tissue.

Uncharacterized; reporter around the notch (Wang 2023 Fig S2D-F, LW1054); cluster 11 DE pct 0.457 vs 0.011.
Cytochrome P450; reporter around the notch (Wang 2023 LRY280); DE in cluster 11 (0.497 vs 0.057) and 19.
bZIP; subapical (SCZ) reporter (Romani 2024 Fig 4A, S2). ID from DS1 only (absent from UniProt).
C2H2 zinc finger; SCZ-only reporter at day 0, later in differentiated cells (Romani 2024 Fig S2).
C2H2 zinc finger; SCZ-only reporter at day 0, later in differentiated cells (Romani 2024 Fig 6A).
bZIP; SCZ reporter at day 0, later in differentiated cells (Romani 2024 Fig 6A). Broad in Wang 2023 (cluster 17 DE 0.911 vs 0.543).
A-type cyclin; CYCA1;1::Citrine at the notch (Wang 2023 Fig 7D); cluster 11 DE pct 0.38 vs 0.009. ID from Wang text (UniProt: uncharacterized).
Plant-specific B-type CDK of G2/M; Wang 2023 cluster 11 DE pct 0.432 vs 0.014. ID from Wang text and DE table.
Cyclin N-terminal domain protein; notch reporter (Wang 2023 LRY067); cluster 11 DE pct 0.279 vs 0.015.

R2R3-MYB essential for gemma cup initiation (Yasui 2019 as cited); weak in Wang 2023 scRNA, on its protoplast-induced list, no gemma reporter signal (Romani 2024 DS1).
NAC; gemma-cup reporter in mature thallus (Romani 2024 Fig 8B), broad in gemma (DS1).
AP2/ERF; gemma-cup reporter in mature thallus (Romani 2024 Fig 8B), SCZ/DDCZ in gemma.

MIXTA-lineage R2R3-MYB (MpR2R3-MYB17) called a dorsal-epidermis marker by Wang 2023 (citing Xu 2021 cuticle study); DE in clusters 7, 11, 17; gemma reporter SCZ/DDCZ/mucilage (Romani 2024 DS1).

NAC; reporter in the gemma border domain (Romani 2024 Fig 5B, 7A), weak elsewhere; moves to the centre after 2 d. Hypothetical domain. Wang DE cluster 17 (0.838 vs 0.211). ID from DS1 (absent from UniProt).
ARF; border reporter (Romani 2024 DS1), matching a knock-in (Kato 2020 as cited), but also SCZ/DDCZ/mucilage = 2.
LBD; reporter only in gemma attachment cells (Romani 2024 Fig 5B, 7B, S4), but also gemma initials, cup mucilage cells and slime papillae in thallus: a shared papilla/initial program.
